changelog: **Configuration changes are audited with a redacted before/after diff (#1699):** `redactedDiff()` (`src/lib/events/diff.ts`) is the one diff helper — an explicit per-field policy (`record` / `redact` / `ignore`), unlisted fields redacted, secret-shaped field names redacted whatever the spec says, and an 8-hex SHA-256 fingerprint so a real certificate change differs from a re-save. The organization PATCH raises `org.config.changed`, the webhook routes `webhook.registered` / `webhook.updated` / `webhook.deleted`, the API-key routes `apikey.created` / `apikey.revoked`; the new `config-audit` subscriber writes one `AuditLog` row per event (tenant-stamped, so it reaches the audit drain). The existing `ActivityLog` entries are unchanged.

en: Changes to your organization's SSO, branding, webhooks and API keys are now recorded in the audit trail with the previous and the new value — certificates and secrets only ever as "changed".
tr: Kurumunuzun SSO, marka, webhook ve API anahtarı ayarlarındaki değişiklikler artık denetim kaydına eski ve yeni değeriyle yazılıyor — sertifika ve sırlar yalnızca "değişti" olarak.
de: Änderungen an SSO, Branding, Webhooks und API-Schlüsseln Ihrer Organisation werden jetzt mit altem und neuem Wert im Audit-Protokoll festgehalten — Zertifikate und Geheimnisse nur als „geändert“.
